'''Nerub Nebb''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[biochemist]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], Nebb managed a small shop, also teaching the knowledge of biochemistry to others.
